lines.text: Jake pulled his beanie on at the cold trailhead.
On the climb, his head got hot and sweaty, so he stuffed the beanie in his pocket.
Then the ridge wind hit his bare, damp ears.
On the climb, wear an ear warmer headband.
It covers your ears and lets heat escape from the top of your head.
Save the beanie for the stops.
Jake reached the ridge dry and warm.
Save this before your next cold hike.
